selection.roadmapLane: P2 original-request custody and local recovery
selection.finiteSlice: Bind the explicit V5 owner to the existing V5 declared-response observation store; confirm response readback before callback completion and fence selected-grant unobserved dispatch intents before new admission.
selection.completedWorkNotRerun: The previous four V5 store cases and earlier V4 owner, HTTP, runner and process outcomes remain retained. This run executes six new owner-binding cases, including a selected V4 control.

sourceChanges.compatibilityLimit: The existing V2/V3/V4 factory bodies remain byte-identical; selected V4 controls are not a full historical regression suite.

selection.ownership: Primary implementation and independent complete joined-outcome review. No worker, automation, model setting or session was modified.

implementation.callbackContract: The dispatch callback returns a supported native Promise of canonical JSON.stringify({ok:true,resultCode}). submitOriginal still resolves to undefined; it does not return authenticated service success.
completionFence: Validate the canonical bounded response JSON
Match current funding to the retained dispatch context
Re-read and validate the exact original and intent
Validate its original/intent digests, funding, policy, scope and powerless flags
Confirm exact response readback and stable funding
implementation.responseGrammar: The existing result-code key grammar and canonical two-field successful JSON, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes. Void, malformed, noncanonical and unsupported/unobservable callback returns are not synthesized into success.
implementation.constructorProbe: A read-only frozen-DATA capability probe refuses missing, accessor, proxy, asynchronous, foreign-key or incompatible profile interfaces before any quarantine write. Interface shape is not a native-store brand or authentication.
implementation.admission: After the probe, compare funding around a bounded selected-grant unobserved-intent query. A retained unobserved intent attempts the existing one-time insert-only quarantine latch before accepting another original.
implementation.grantBoundary: Foreign grant input is refused before action. A valid foreign grant's pending intent does not quarantine the selected grant; the native store still validates its complete bounded contents.
implementation.recoveryProjection: readOriginalRecoveryState includes a detached frozen responseObservation or null and a responseStatus. Existing intent and UNKNOWN/quarantine metadata remain intact, with authority NONE and serviceOutcome NOT_ESTABLISHED.
implementation.responseWitnesses: A bounded per-selected-request checksum index detects later observed-response loss or change. It retains no response body or proof; it is memory-only and does not survive construction of a new owner.
implementation.witnessLimit: Pending submission closures retain the data needed for fencing until completion/uncertainty. No secure memory erasure, restoration, anti-rollback or same-user-writer defense is claimed.
implementation.close: Observable pending callback work may finish response persistence/readback while owner close drains. Borrowed owners never close the store. Unknown outcomes keep close UNKNOWN rather than reporting a successful drain.
implementation.hashOperations: Existing SHA-256 consistency bindings only; no key generation or signing.
implementation.checksumTrust: Observation field and original/intent digest bindings are checked. As with V4 quarantine, native-store checksum correctness is a trusted synchronous-interface premise, not remote authentication.

sourceBinding.newBuiltinUse: The owner uses node:crypto createHash for original/intent digest consistency; no key or signature API is invoked.

execution.fixedInlineRunner: One exact positional fixture, six exact test names and matched complete diagnostics; Node builtin test/util/reporters/stream APIs. Not a saved or installed operational helper.
execution.limitBoundary: These timeouts are not hard lifetime/cancellation/native-cleanup guarantees or an OS/network sandbox. Loader, runner, stream, SQLite, sync and OS behavior remain premises.
execution.processBoundary: Normal in-process owner/store close and reopen only. No forced kill, crash, fresh-process, operating-system restart, power-loss or physical-durability test.

cases.name: V5 owner confirms bound response readback before callback completion and refuses implicit replay
cases.observed: Four hostile/asynchronous/foreign capability configurations are refused without invoking getters or writing quarantine. A real V5 owner refuses foreign submit before action, persists the original and intent before callback, confirms a declared response before completion, and refuses implicit original replay.

cases.name: V5 drain and normal reopen preserve observations without clearing intents or adopting foreign pending work
cases.observed: Owner close waits for an observable pending reply. Its response observation is persisted/read back while draining. Normal store reopen keeps prior originals, intents and observations; selected grant A accepts a new original while valid foreign grant B retains an unobserved intent.

cases.name: V4 callback semantics remain distinct and incompatible V5 owner probing does not quarantine V4
cases.observed: The V4 owner still accepts its void callback contract and has no response counters/projection. The incompatible V5 capability probe refuses a real V4 store without changing funding or writing quarantine. Its closed file remains byte/identity identical through the later V5 cases.

cases.name: V5 startup quarantines a retained unobserved intent before any new dispatch or retention
cases.observed: After normal reopen, selected grant B's retained unobserved intent automatically latches quarantine before any new retention or callback. Same-original and fresh submits are blocked; recovery retains the exact original/intent with response null and authority NONE.

cases.name: V5 void invalid and unobservable callback replies remain UNKNOWN without response synthesis
cases.observed: Void, noncanonical JSON and unsupported bare-string replies produce UNKNOWN, insert no response observation, attempt one quarantine per owner, reject subsequent fresh work and retain the original and dispatch intent.

cases.name: V5 post-commit and readback faults retain observations but never report confirmed completion
cases.observed: One forwarding exception is deliberately thrown after the native observation write commits; another forwarder hides the readback. Both preserve real committed rows but report UNKNOWN with zero confirmed completions. Recovery also refuses a valid foreign-grant observation, an accessor-bearing record and loss of an already witnessed response without invoking a getter.

preservation.originalPaymentRequestAuthority: Preserve the original payment/request bytes, hash, payload, requirements, context and consumed authority.
preservation.pr193: VALIDATED possible exact-same-signed-block resend remains distinct from UNKNOWN and ACKNOWLEDGED. No resend, replacement, re-signing or settlement is executed.

reviewDiagnostics.olderFailuresAndRefusals: Retained unchanged; not converted into fresh passing executions.

rawSqlite.role: V5 owner response and quarantine component fixture

storage.quotaLimit: Cooperative bounded allocation and sampled monitoring, not an atomic OS-enforced aggregate quota.

evidenceEfficiency.binaryTransport: Bounded descriptor streams with one CAS object per digest; no second stdout copy, ZIP packaging or raw SQLite adoption.

nextFiniteWork: Explicitly bind the existing strict HTTP reply path to the V5 owner and V5 owned-store profile, preserving the current default and V4 factories, exact original/intent custody, UNKNOWN boundaries and one-grant authority.
